title: Gold and Silver ALERT: The Bull Case Goes Beyond the Chart
speaker: Jeffrey Christian (CPM Group)

macro_themes.view: Price direction comes from macro and supply-demand research; technicals only for pacing and timing.
Excluding investment demand, silver was in surplus in three of the last five years; deficits only in the last two as prices rose.
Platinum is well supplied with an enlarged surplus; palladium's balance is tighter.

calls.reason: Range-bound after breaking shorter trend lines; trend line from January 2024 supports ~4,000; near-term downside room, but macro/political and supply-demand fundamentals point higher longer term.
calls.quote: yes there is some downside room on the uh near-term but longer term we expect gold prices to continue to rise

calls.condition: Even in a sell-off he expects silver to hold above ~54-55.
calls.reason: Similar to gold: near-term weakness possible but longer-term rise on macro view and fundamentals (investment-driven deficits only in the last two years).
calls.quote: Our expectation is that the price will probably stay above 54-55 even if we do see a sell-off

calls.reason: Surplus of refined platinum has enlarged this year with large above-ground inventories (~14-15 Moz), consistent with lower prices since January; market relatively well supplied.
calls.quote: So platinum markets relatively well supplied

calls.reason: Supply-demand balance much tighter than platinum, so recent greater weakness surprises them (implied relative bullishness).
calls.quote: we think that the demand supply demand balance for palladium is much tighter than that of platinum

notes: Date from transcript: 'about five minutes after 12:00 noon here in New York on Tuesday the 6th of October' (listing approx_date 2026-10-07). Garbled: gold intraday high '$4,28' read as 4,228; silver trend-line support '28 $30' looks garbled (inconsistent with his 54-55 floor) and was omitted from key_levels; palladium bias is inferred from his surprise at its weakness, not an explicit forecast. Much of video is rebuttal of comments and scam warnings (no calls).
